settings.eyebrow: Our approach / From first thought to entry
settings.title: From first thought to front door.
settings.text: A beautiful entrance begins with the feeling you want people to have when they arrive. The rest is a series of thoughtful choices, made together.

settings.title: See it all together.
settings.text: Gather your palette, scale, and finishing details in one place. When it feels like yours, approve the design for cart review. You can still revise it and approve again. This step is not an order or a date reservation; checkout is available only when the offers are ready.

settings.title: Tell us when it matters.
settings.text: Have a gathering in mind? Share the week you’re hoping for, and include an event date in your notes. It’s a request rather than a booking; we’ll confirm availability and timing separately.

settings.title: Make the welcome yours.
settings.text: Choose installation to have the display styled at your entry, or delivery if you’d rather arrange it yourself. Add your PNG or PDF artwork to a white or orange pumpkin with white, black, or gold vinyl, or request post-season removal. We’ll confirm the details and pricing before checkout.
